tools.name: MLC Public Work Search
tools.what: Look up who owns which share of a song in the MLC database. Shows ownership data only, not what a song has earned.
tools.note: Holder's tools page says it is free to anyone; the portal page showed no text to automated reading. Open by hand.

tools.name: MLC Missing Member Lookup
tools.what: Search a name to see whether the MLC may hold US digital mechanicals for a rightsholder who has not joined. Leaves out historical unmatched money.

tools.name: MLC royalty dashboards
tools.what: Public MLC pages charting royalty totals: blanket royalties since 2021, historical 2007-2020 by rate period and service, and unclaimed 2021 usage by month.
tools.note: Each dashboard sits on a public MLC page that opened without sign-in.

tools.name: MLC Matching and Claiming tools
tools.what: Portal tools to claim missing shares of registered songs and to propose matches between unmatched recordings and your songs.
tools.note: Sign in to the Member Hub (matching also in the Songwriter Hub). The MLC says connecting with it is free.

tools.name: Django Music Publisher
tools.what: Open-source software you install and run yourself to keep song metadata, register and license works and process publishing royalties.
tools.note: MIT licence per the repository; installed from PyPI and needs technical skill to run.

tools.name: Songview
tools.what: Joint ASCAP and BMI project, with GMR and SESAC, that reconciles US performing-rights ownership shares; links out to the ASCAP and BMI searches.
tools.note: Landing page has no search of its own and states no login or cost for the searches it links to.

tools.name: BMI Repertoire
tools.what: Search BMI's catalogue for works, writers and publishers to see ownership shares held at BMI.
tools.note: Showed a human-verification page to automated reading; open by hand to confirm what it shows and any login.

tools.name: ASCAP ACE Repertory
tools.what: Search ASCAP's repertory for works and their ownership data.
tools.note: Blocked automated reading (403). Open by hand to confirm what it shows and any login.

tools.name: SESAC Repertory
tools.what: Search works SESAC represents by title, work number, writer, publisher or artist; shows SESAC's share and its writers and publishers.
tools.note: You accept extra terms of use before searching; SESAC warns results may be incomplete.

tools.name: PRS works search
tools.what: PRS for Music page on searching its works database by title, writer, publisher or code.
tools.note: Only the page title loaded for automated reading; search fields, public view and login are unconfirmed.

tools.name: GEMA repertoire search
tools.what: Link to GEMA's online works search, set beside a separate login and registration option.
tools.note: Page links to the search on portal.gema.de, which showed no text to automated reading; login and coverage unconfirmed.

tools.name: SOCAN public repertoire search
tools.what: Search works SOCAN can license, including foreign works, by title, creator, publisher, performer or work number. Leaves out AV productions and cues.
tools.note: Opened 2026-11-20 but showed a maintenance notice; confirm the search works and is the current one.

tools.name: ISRC Search
tools.what: Look up recording identifiers (ISRCs) held in SoundExchange data, to find or check a code for a track.
tools.note: Tool page is script-driven and showed no text to automated reading; data source and access unconfirmed.

tools.name: ISWC Network
tools.what: Portal for looking up and managing international identifiers (ISWC) for musical works.
tools.note: Only the page title loaded for automated reading; search scope and access unconfirmed.

tools.name: ISNI database
tools.what: Public database of persistent identifiers for creators and organisations, useful to tell similarly named people apart.
tools.note: Home page links to a database search but states no cost or login; the search page returned 403 to automated reading.

tools.name: US Copyright Office Public Records
tools.what: Search copyright registrations and recorded documents held by the Copyright Office.
tools.note: Only the page title loaded for automated reading; coverage and access unconfirmed.

tools.name: DDEX Validator
tools.what: Online checker for delivery messages in the DDEX standard before sending them to a service.
tools.note: Only the page title loaded for automated reading; supported messages and access unconfirmed.

tools.name: Curve Royalty Tools
tools.what: Royalty calculation tools from a statement-software vendor.
tools.note: Fetch returned HTTP 402; whether it is free, login or paid is unconfirmed.

tools.name: Session Studio
tools.what: Free app on web, desktop and mobile for sharing song ideas with collaborators and keeping song credits organised.
tools.note: Page says the app is free and has sign-up buttons; it does not state whether an account is required.

tools.name: RapidCue
tools.what: Web Edition application site with resources for batch submitters and links to the ASCAP and BMI searches.
tools.note: Home page does not say it handles cue sheets, who may use it, login or cost. Confirm by hand.

tools.name: ValuePunks
tools.what: Estimates a value range for a catalogue from last year's revenue by rights type, using a discounted cash flow model.
tools.note: Page says the standard report is free; whether an account is required is not stated.

tools.name: Music Business Toolbox
tools.what: Music business templates and calculators, including split agreements, budgets and contracts, in a paid subscription with a small free set.
tools.note: Split, budget and contract tools are in the paid tier; the free tier has a checklist and guides.

tools.name: Songtrust resource centre
tools.what: Guides, checklists and a split sheet from a publishing administrator, plus a streaming-royalty estimator.
tools.note: Page does not label items as free or gated; some downloads link to forms. Estimator access unconfirmed.

tools.name: Harry Fox Agency
tools.what: Harry Fox Agency site, now a joint Rumblefish and HFA platform; links to Songfile, a service for licensing cover songs.
tools.note: Home page shows no public song search and no prices; Songfile itself was not opened.
